summary: Full backend + frontend testing completed for Tranquilário Studio. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (health, root, contact create, validation, persistence, sort order, no _id leakage). All requested frontend flows pass: hero/sessions/testimonials render, nav-link scrolling works, language toggle switches EN↔DE↔IT↔PT and persists to localStorage (verified tranq_lang='de'), hero/session translations visibly change, testimonials carousel prev/next work (4 cards present), contact form submits and shows success message, email/phone/WhatsApp links present, mobile menu toggle opens/closes on 390px viewport.

issues: Footer headline appears to display in German ('Gönnen Sie sich diese besondere Erfahrung.') while the rest of the page is in English. May be intentional multi-language stylistic choice, but worth confirming with main agent.

action_items: Confirm whether Footer headline language behavior is intentional (currently shows German on EN page).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside create_contact (line 66, 69) but logging.basicConfig + logger assignment happen AFTER include_router. Works because the function runs later, but cleaner to initialize logger before routes.

server.py: create_contact wraps everything in try/except returning 500 — this swallows Pydantic validation errors as 500. Fortunately Pydantic validation runs before the function body so 422 is still raised correctly. No bug, but the broad except is a smell.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') (FastAPI lifespan recommended in 2026).
GET /api/contacts is publicly exposed without auth — leaks user PII (names, emails, messages). Should require authentication or be removed in production.
Contact list endpoint reads up to 100 contacts with no pagination cursor — fine for MVP but flag for scale.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed contacts via POST /api/contact during pytest and Playwright runs (TEST_User Wellness, TEST_A, TEST_B, TEST_Playwright User). Safe to leave; main agent may purge if desired.
